title: Shared placements and planned events
summary: Changes are proposed with affected-output plans before applying one shared mutation.
semantics: planPlacementAdd and planOverrideChange complement planNodeChange and planFactChange and are non-mutating until accepted.
Template placement changes reach every inheriting document even when a node was previously absent.
Template-layer override changes reach inherited consumers; local document/project/variant changes affect only that document.
Lower-layer changes that are shadowed by deliberate local overrides report OVERRIDE.SHADOWS WARN without overwriting.
Apply uses a revision fence and records a logical predecessor event; it is not a durable cryptographic hash chain.
Direct mutators remain exposed and must be sealed before event-only enforcement can be claimed.
